verdict.rationale: Railway's built-in dashboard agent turns the user's platform data into AI insights and suggestions. It inspects deployments, reads logs, diagnoses failed deployments automatically, and proposes fixes as pull requests. The evidence covers only deployment and failure diagnostics. Nothing shows insights over metrics, usage or cost, or the user's application data, and no hands-on report confirms the quality of the insights. missing for 10: proactive insights from metrics/dashboards or usage/cost data, insights over application or database data, independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The Railway Agent is a chat-based AI assistant built into the Railway dashboard. It can operate the platform on your behalf: creating and configuring services, inspecting deployments, diagnosing failures, and opening pull requests to fix broken builds.
Identify the cause of a failed deployment and open a pull request against your repository with a proposed fix.
When a deployment fails, the agent can automatically investigate.
Mention @Railway in Slack to ask the Railway Agent about your projects, inspect deployments, read logs, and make changes without leaving the conversation.
